summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Enzo Traverso, an Italian historian. It gives his birth date and place and notes that his scholarship focuses on the Holocaust and totalitarianism. It also records his long residence in France and his current academic post at Cornell University.
one_line: Enzo Traverso is an Italian historian known for work on the Holocaust and totalitarianism, now at Cornell University.
key_facts: Enzo Traverso was born on 14 October 1957 in Gavi, Piedmont region, Italy.
Enzo Traverso is an Italian historian.
Enzo Traverso has written on issues relating to the Holocaust.
Enzo Traverso has written on issues relating to totalitarianism.
Enzo Traverso lived and worked in France for over 20 years.
Enzo Traverso is currently the Susan and Barton Winokur Professor in the Humanities at Cornell University.
